setup: [a message that looks like it comes from the player's bank or wallet app says the account will be blocked today unless identity details are updated]
ask: [the message, in the bank's name, asks the player to open a link, log in, and read back a code to confirm the update before the account is blocked tonight]
usualEnding: The login and the code empty the account, or a loan is opened in the player's name. The real check lives inside the official app, opened by the player.
realTwin: A real alert from [institution] confirms a purchase the player just made, with no link and no code to read back, and the detail matches the official app.
